referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The module calls the module "natural gas, burned in gas turbine", GLO, which in turn includes fuel input, infrastructure, and emissions. The module uses the estimated average net efficiency of a gas turbine. Heat waste of electricity output is subtracted to avoid double counting because it is already fully considered in "natural gas, burned in gas turbine" and will be considered in application of electricity module.; Geography: Global range of electric efficiency assumed 25% to 39%
